summary: The main article describes the synthesis and application of dicyanopyrazine (DPZ) derivatives as organic photoredox catalysts. It includes 3 tables for optimization and scope of cross-dehydrogenative-coupling (CDC) reactions, along with 7 figures detailing catalyst structures, photophysical properties, and proposed mechanisms.
